design: Adaptive sequential kill screen, not a factorial DOE

states.decision_observation: fixture-only and sleeve-only load/compliance/leak, marker visibility and zero drift

states.curvature_path: sub-threshold then adaptive up to safe pre-onset
states.decision_observation: seek slip-only while checking no transformation signature

states.curvature_path: same safe curvature path as C1
states.decision_observation: test whether contact restraint shifts slip onset without inferring f_n=p

states.curvature_path: adaptive steps toward independently estimated transformation onset
states.decision_observation: look for simultaneous validated slip and transformation-sensitive signals

states.curvature_path: only safe curvature states from C3
states.decision_observation: test whether pressure suppresses slip while transformation remains; optional regime

states.pressure_level: one selected pressure and safe curvature that was most informative
states.decision_observation: test temperature/rate dependence, channel noise, temporal overlap, training/wear and integrity

pressure_levels: Ambient differential baseline plus low and higher approved nonzero pressure; actual numeric values TO_BE_SELECTED_BY_HUMAN after certified rating/leak checks.
curvature_levels: Measured below and toward batch-specific onset, always inside selected safe limits; numeric values TO_BE_MEASURED/TO_BE_SELECTED_BY_HUMAN.
rates: At least two distinguishable actual local rates or a slow/dwell contrast; numeric rates TO_BE_SELECTED_BY_HUMAN after thermal calibration.
classification_rule: Assign no-slip/no-transformation, slip-only, transformation-only or coexistence only from corrected local channels with uncertainty and matched time windows; unresolvable states remain INDETERMINATE.
optional_cell_rule: C4 transformation-only is attempted only if C3 or calibration demonstrates a safe transformation-active path; inability to realize it does not alone fail coexistence.
